messages.subject: New Tinn-R version 3.0.3.6 every now and then unresponsive
messages.subject_clean: New Tinn-R version 3.0.3.6 every now and then unresponsive
messages.body_plain:
Thanks to all of you who develop and take care of Tinn-R.

I have the following problem. After I updated Tinn-R to version 3.0.3.6 and use R version 3.1.0 Tinn-R becomes every now and then (sometimes every 5-10 seconds!) unresponsive for 1-2 seconds. I working with Win 7 on a laptop with Intel i5.

Are there any ideas how to avoid this and make a fluent use of Tinn-R possible?

( I speculate that this might have something to do with the apparent use of the internet by Tinn-R (see e.g. menue: [options][Application options][general] and there 'beep if no internet connection'.)

Thanks for any help!

Cheers,
Andreas
